vendeur.faq1Q: Can I sell gaming top-ups (Free Fire, Robux, PUBG)?
vendeur.faq1A: Absolutely! TEKÇA is built for digital content sellers. You can sell Free Fire diamonds, Robux, passes or gift cards. Delivering player IDs or codes is smooth and fast.
vendeur.faq2Q: How is my payment guaranteed when I deliver a top-up or digital code?
vendeur.faq2A: Thanks to our escrow system (SebPay), the buyer deposits the money before you process the top-up. Once delivery is done and confirmed, your funds are automatically released to your seller balance. Zero risk of handing out diamonds without getting paid.
vendeur.faq3Q: How do I withdraw my sales earnings to Mobile Money?
vendeur.faq3A: It's instant. From your seller dashboard, you request a withdrawal to your Mobile Money (MTN, Airtel, etc.), confirm it with your secret PIN, and the money lands directly on your phone.
vendeur.faq4Q: Why isn't communication done through WhatsApp?
vendeur.faq4A: On WhatsApp, there's no protection against scams. TEKÇA's encrypted internal messaging is directly linked to the escrow system to protect both buyer and seller in case of a dispute.
vendeur.faq5Q: Could my account or balance get hacked?
vendeur.faq5A: No. Every withdrawal request requires your secret PIN, and our system includes an anti-brute-force security log that blocks any suspicious attempt.
vendeur.faq6Q: Do I need administrative paperwork (business registration) to sell?
vendeur.faq6A: No paperwork is required. You sign up for free and can start selling your top-ups or items right away.
